name: Completed lifecycle stages remain view-only in the same application
description:
Objective: Completed lifecycle stages remain view-only for the controlled Merchant Call application.
Preconditions: Authenticated QA user; MERCHANT_CALL_APPLICATION_URL identifies APP-2026-000262 in Contract Signed or Deal Created state.
Steps:
1. Open the exact controlled application and reconcile API/UI identity.
2. Open Underwriting, Offer, Stipulations, and Contract.
3. Verify completed data.
4. Prove mutation controls are disabled or absent.
5. Return to the current workflow.
Expected: Every prior stage retains APP-2026-000262 context, displays completed data, and prevents historical mutation.
